trust_decision.summary: The --studio server trusts every caller and every request-body string: POST /api/execute (agent, prompt) and POST /api/install-agent (agentName) are passed to child_process.spawn with shell:true, and the server listens on all interfaces with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; the decision is made in the route handlers and their helpers, with no shared auth or validation guard.

landing_point.why: The summary's 'request-body fields passed into spawn(..., { shell: true })' first matches the local task executor: /api/execute is the only state-changing route the bundled UI calls (cli-tool/src/sandbox-interface.html:958) and it hands the free-text prompt straight to spawn('claude', [finalPrompt], { shell: true }).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/execute -> agent install helper (local and cloud modes)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The shipped Studio UI never calls POST /api/install-agent (its only command-executing call is /api/execute, cli-tool/src/sandbox-interface.html:958), so a solver can call the route unused/dead and leave its agentName shell injection open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate use must keep working: local mode hands arbitrary natural-language prompts (quotes, semicolons, $(), backticks, newlines) to claude as one argv entry, so sanitising or rejecting prompt text breaks the product; and on Windows npx/claude resolve only through their .cmd shims, so dropping shell:true without the shim breaks agent installation and local execution (the fix adds NPX_CMD/CLAUDE_CMD at fix.diff:56-60).

O6_input_shapes: prompt from the JSON body: arbitrary natural-language string with quotes, whitespace, newlines and shell metacharacters (; | && $() `), must arrive as a single argv entry
agentName from the JSON body on /api/install-agent: arbitrary string including ; | $() ` and newlines
agent from the JSON body on /api/execute: same string shapes, used both for the npx install spawn and the 'As a <agent>' prompt prefix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an /api/install-command, /api/install-mcp, /api/install-hook or /api/install-skill route copying the install-agent handler
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the CLI already supports --agent/--command/--mcp/--setting/--hook/--skill (cli-tool/bin/create-claude-config.js:35-41), so a maintainer exposing the Studio would copy the same spawn(..., { shell: true }) call per component type

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second spawn('claude', [prompt], { shell: true }) prompt-execution path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it exists in the real tree for the --prompt flow (called at cli-tool/src/index.js:477, 2001, 2170); the same primitive is the obvious template for a new route or helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: shell-string interpolation of request fields into sbx.commands.run
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: already present in the real tree (components spliced at :151 and the prompt at :240), so the same mistake in a host-side spawn or a new transport is realistic

O9_family: os_command_injection (CWE-78; the advisory also covers CWE-306 missing authentication and CWE-352 CSRF)

O10_build.toolchain: npm with cli-tool/package-lock.json; Express 4; jest for tests; node >=14 (cli-tool/package.json:87)
O10_build.project_tests: cli-tool/package.json:21 runs jest; the suites under cli-tool/tests/** cover analytics/validation only and none exercises cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js; the fix adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip or reject shell metacharacters in the prompt (or remove shell:true from just the executeLocalTask claude spawn) and declare the reported injection closed.

out_of_scope_notes: cli-tool/src/index.js:2584-2588 (handlePromptExecution) spawns 'claude' with shell:true and the operator's own --prompt value; it is the interactive CLI, not the --studio server, and is not reachable from it — recorded as an O8b sibling only.
cli-tool/components/sandbox/e2b/e2b-launcher.py:151-153 and :240 build shell strings from argv, but they run inside the E2B sandbox, not on the developer host — not pursued.

Other local dashboards (cli-tool/src/analytics.js, chats-mobile.js, teams-dashboard.js, plugin-dashboard.js, skill-dashboard.js) expose unauthenticated routes but are separate features not started by --studio (cli-tool/src/index.js:2632-2646) — not pursued.
